text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The sun has fallen, and all are asleep on
this holy
night. All except...

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Shuffle...

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Hehe, look at Palmer all sound asleep.
Now, for her
present...

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Waheey! Whatcha looking at, Palmer?
Golf stuff?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, I'm checking out these gloves. I've
been
wanting to replace my old pair,
and the latest
ones just dropped.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
But I'm short on cash, so I'm just window
shopping
today. Haha!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Ta-da! A pair of golf gloves, just for you!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Your cheerful personality never fails to
lift my
spirits, Palmer. I hope these are
to your liking.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Now... who's next?

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: Snrk! Zzz...

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Nice, she's fast asleep. I've got just the
thing for a
good girl like her...

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: Waaaah!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Oh dear. What bothers you so,
Fukukitaru?

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Fujiii! I m-misplaced my most precious
lucky
amulet!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Calm down now, deep breaths. Don't
worry, it'll
turn up sooner or later. Do
you remember the last
time you saw it?

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: Gurk! Sniff... Um, I remember bringing it with me to the field...

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
I found your amulet! Hehe, this one took
me a
while—the academy field is quite
large!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
...Anyhow, good thing I could find it. I
hope you
break into that wonderful
smile of yours again.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Time ticks by on this holy night, along
with its
surreptitious surprises.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
I think that's the last of the presents.
Hehe, I can't
wait to see everyone's
faces tomorrow.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: ...Achoo!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Haha, I'm really feeling the cold now.
Guess it's
time to get snug in my bed.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Suddenly, a flash catches Fuji Kiseki's
eye, and
she looks up to the sky. There,
high above the
clouds, she sees...

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
A shooting star on this holy night. What
a stellar
present.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: I might as well make a wish.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Please, grant these girls enough
happiness to last
a lifetime.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Morning arrives, and Ritto Dormitory
buzzes with
festive voices.
